
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # read_csv and mutate
library(lme4)       # lmer
library(emmeans)    # emmeans and pairs
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(performance)
library(modelsummary)
library(lmerTest)

df_long4 <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study5.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task_explanation_group), ref = "predict"),
    feature_relevance = relevel(factor(feature_relevance), ref = "irrelevant"),
    feature_dimension = relevel(factor(feature_dimension), ref = "stripes"),
    stripes_high = relevel(factor(stripes_high), ref = "E"),
    time = relevel(factor(time), ref = "mid"),
    feet_high = relevel(factor(feet_high), ref = "C")
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
contrasts(df_long4$task) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_long4$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

model_eff <- lmer(
  feature_importance ~ task * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1|participant),
  data = df_long4
)
summary(model_eff)
```
```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_relevance * task)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_dimension * task)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```



```{r}
plot_df <- df_long4 %>%
  group_by(task, feature_relevance) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(feature_importance, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = feature_relevance,
    y = mean,
    color = task,
    group = task
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = .3),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    position = position_dodge(width = .3)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean - se,
      ymax = mean + se
    ),
    width = .15,
    position = position_dodge(width = .3)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Feature Relevance",
    y = "feature_importance",
    color = "Task"
  )

```

##PLOTTING

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df_long4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_long_by_explanation_for_R-Study5.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("stripes", "feet"),
      labels = c("Stripes", "Feet")
    ),

    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("mid", "end"),
      labels = c("Mid", "End")
    ),

    # Feature-specific explanation grouping
    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "Predictor",

      task == "accommodate" &
        had_causal_explanation_for_feature == TRUE ~ "Explainer",

      task == "accommodate" &
        (
          had_causal_explanation_for_feature == FALSE |
          is.na(had_causal_explanation_for_feature)
        ) ~ "Non-explainer",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "Explainer",
        "Non-explainer",
        "Predictor"
      )
    )
  )


# Check participant counts by feature, time, and group
df_long4 |>
  count(
    time,
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  )


# Calculate means, SDs, SEs, and participant counts
plot_summary <- df_long4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(feature_importance),
    !is.na(time)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    time,
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_importance = mean(
      feature_importance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_importance = sd(
      feature_importance,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_importance = sd_importance / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

plot_summary
make_importance_plot <- function(summary_data, timepoint) {

  summary_data |>
    filter(time == timepoint) |>
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = feature_dimension,
        y = mean_importance,
        fill = feature_explanation_group
      )
    ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(
        ymin = mean_importance - se_importance,
        ymax = mean_importance + se_importance
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        y = -0.5,
        label = paste0("n = ", n)
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      size = 2.5,
      vjust = 1
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-1, 7.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(timepoint, " Ratings"),
      x = "Feature",
      y = "Mean feature importance",
      fill = "Condition"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14)
}
```

```{r}
plot_mid <- make_importance_plot(
  plot_summary,
  "Mid"
)

plot_end <- make_importance_plot(
  plot_summary,
  "End"
)

plot_mid
plot_end
```

###ERRORS

```{r}
df_merged <- read_csv('/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_merged_for_R-Study5.csv') |>
  mutate(
    task = relevel(factor(task), ref = "predict"),

    stripes_relevance = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "stripes", "irrelevant", "relevant"),
    feet_relevance  = ifelse(irrelevant_dim == "feet", "irrelevant", "relevant"),

    stripes_match_high = ifelse(stripes == stripes_high, 1, 0),
    feet_match_high  = ifelse(feet == feet_high, 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
df_cue <- df_merged |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      stripes_match_high,
      feet_match_high
    ),
    names_to = "feature_dimension",
    values_to = "match_high"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    feature_dimension = str_remove(
      feature_dimension,
      "_match_high"
    ),

    feature_relevance = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "stripes" ~ stripes_relevance,
      feature_dimension == "feet"  ~ feet_relevance
    ),

    # Did the accommodator explain this particular feature?
    explained_feature = case_when(
      feature_dimension == "stripes" ~ causal_stripes,
      feature_dimension == "feet"  ~ causal_feet
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(
    task,
    conditionOrder,
    relevant_dim,
    irrelevant_dim,
    feature_dimension,
    feature_relevance,
    explained_feature
  ) |>
  summarise(
    # Participant's feature effect
    pred = mean(
      testing_responses[match_high == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) -
      mean(
        testing_responses[match_high == 0],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    # True feature effect in the training
    true = mean(
      fertility_score[match_high == 1],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) -
      mean(
        fertility_score[match_high == 0],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signed_error = pred - true,
    abs_error = abs(signed_error),

    feature_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "predictor",

      task == "accommodate" &
        explained_feature %in% TRUE ~ "explainer",

      task == "accommodate" ~ "non_explainer",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    task = relevel(
      factor(task),
      ref = "predict"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("stripes", "feet"),
      labels = c("Stripes", "Feet")
    ),

    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "explainer",
        "non_explainer",
        "predictor"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Explainer",
        "Non-explainer",
        "Predictor"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r}
error_plot_summary <- df_cue |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(abs_error)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_abs_error = mean(abs_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_abs_error = sd(abs_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n_distinct(conditionOrder),
    se_abs_error = sd_abs_error / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

error_plot_summary

ggplot(
  error_plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_abs_error,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_abs_error - se_abs_error,
      ymax = mean_abs_error + se_abs_error
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = 0,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Absolute error",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```

###Correlations

```{r}
df_corr4 <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_by_explanation_for_R-Study5.csv"
) |>
  mutate(
    feature_relevance = relevel(
      factor(feature_relevance),
      ref = "irrelevant"
    ),

    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("stripes", "feet"),
      labels = c("stripes", "Feet")
    ),

    feature_explanation_group = factor(
      feature_explanation_group,
      levels = c(
        "explainer",
        "non_explainer",
        "predictor"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Explainer",
        "Non-explainer",
        "Predictor"
      )
    )
  )


# Check participant counts in each group
df_corr4 |>
  count(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  )


# Means, SDs, SEs, and participant n
corr_plot_summary <- df_corr4 |>
  filter(
    !is.na(feature_explanation_group),
    !is.na(feature_dimension),
    !is.na(correlation)
  ) |>
  group_by(
    feature_dimension,
    feature_explanation_group
  ) |>
  summarise(
    mean_correlation = mean(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sd_correlation = sd(
      correlation,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n = n_distinct(participant),
    se_correlation = sd_correlation / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

corr_plot_summary


# Plot mean correlations by explanation group
ggplot(
  corr_plot_summary,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean_correlation,
    fill = feature_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_correlation - se_correlation,
      ymax = mean_correlation + se_correlation
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      y = -0.15,
      label = paste0("n = ", n)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = 1
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.25, 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Feature",
    y = "Mean correlation",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)
```
